advisories.title: Node.js 20 runtime older than 20.18.1 misses published security releases (fixture)
remediation_steps: Upgrade the declared Node.js runtime to a patched release on a supported line.
Rebuild and redeploy the application and its container image after the upgrade.

advisories.title: Adobe Commerce versions before the 2.4.8-p3 hotfix are exposed to a known-exploited session flaw (fixture)
remediation_steps: Apply the vendor security hotfix for your Adobe Commerce release line.
Verify the hotfix is installed on the deployed instance; a version string alone does not prove it.
Rebuild and redeploy the application image after patching.

advisories.title: PHP 8.1 has reached end of life and no longer receives security fixes (fixture)
remediation_steps: Move the declared PHP runtime to a line that still receives security fixes.
Rebuild and redeploy the application and its container image after the upgrade.
